name: ecy-review
description: Review AI-generated work before ECY uses, sends, publishes, or delivers it.

interface.longDescription: Reviews AI-generated research, product content, emails, data, presentations, images, agent work, and business analysis. It finds concrete problems, separates review from rewriting, and identifies what people should verify first.
defaultPrompt: 检查这个产物是否可以交付。
重点找出最值得人工确认的三个问题。
对照附件中的原始资料做深度审查。
